min_row, max_row = 1, 53
min_col, max_col = 1, 3

# Capture original cell styles for the allowed range so rewritten cells keep the same appearance
styles = {}
for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(r, c)
        styles[(r, c)] = {
            "font": copy.copy(cell.font),
            "fill": copy.copy(cell.fill),
            "border": copy.copy(cell.border),
            "alignment": copy.copy(cell.alignment),
            "number_format": cell.number_format,
            "protection": copy.copy(cell.protection),
        }

# Keep header row and rows from row 2 onward where Column C does NOT end with 'L'
kept_rows = []
for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    row_values = [ws.cell(r, c).value for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1)]
    if r == 1:
        kept_rows.append(row_values)
    else:
        col_c_value = ws.cell(r, 3).value
        text = "" if col_c_value is None else str(col_c_value).strip()
        if not text.endswith("L"):
            kept_rows.append(row_values)

# Clear and rewrite only A1:C53
for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(r, c)
        cell.value = None
        style = styles[(r, c)]
        cell.font = copy.copy(style["font"])
        cell.fill = copy.copy(style["fill"])
        cell.border = copy.copy(style["border"])
        cell.alignment = copy.copy(style["alignment"])
        cell.number_format = style["number_format"]
        cell.protection = copy.copy(style["protection"])

for idx, row_values in enumerate(kept_rows[:max_row], start=1):
    for c, value in enumerate(row_values, start=1):
        ws.cell(idx, c).value = value
